executive_summary: Clarion Data Systems demonstrates a solid understanding of the core technical requirements, confirming real-time dashboard capabilities, PostgreSQL integration without migration, role-based access control, and low-stock alerts. However, the proposal suffers from critical omissions regarding exact pricing, definitive timelines, SLAs, and formal risk documentation, making it a conditional candidate pending major clarifications.
strengths: Correctly identifies and confirms support for the existing PostgreSQL database without requiring a database migration.
Accurately addresses the core role-based access control needs (warehouse managers vs. HQ staff).
Demonstrates relevant regional experience in the DACH logistics sector.
weaknesses_and_gaps: Timeline is vague ('aim to complete full rollout within the timeframe you've outlined') and defers exact scheduling to discovery, failing to commit to the mandatory 3-month pilot and 6-month full rollout.
Pricing is provided as a broad range (€70,000 to €110,000) and deferred for a firm quote, failing to lock into a definite fixed price within the client's €80,000–€120,000 budget.
Fails to specify post-go-live support terms, response times, or formal Service Level Agreements (SLAs).
Omits the required documentation of assumptions, limitations, and operational risks.

scorecard.evaluation_notes: Proposal explicitly confirms a web-based real-time dashboard across all 6 warehouses.
Confirms integration on top of the existing PostgreSQL database without schema migration.
Directly addresses site-specific manager visibility versus overarching HQ staff visibility.
Confirms configurable thresholds per item with automated notifications to managers.
Mentions phased onboarding to reduce disruption, but fails to commit to the specific 3-month pilot and 6-month full rollout schedule.
Completely omits post-go-live support terms, response times, and SLAs.

scorecard.requirement_title: Documentation of Assumptions, Limitations, and Risks
scorecard.evaluation_notes: No section addressing project assumptions, technical limitations, or risk mitigation.
